title: Battle of Speyerbach
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Speyerbach", at revision 1370589778, opens: "The Battle of Speyerbach took place on 15 November 1703 during the War of the Spanish Succession, near Speyer in the Rhineland-Palatinate. A French army commanded by Camille de Tallard defeated an Allied force under Frederick of Hesse." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q571861, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1703 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
